purpose: Inputs to the ALL_NODE retrieval_role decision, measured before the decision is written into nodes.parquet. This file ranks nothing and prefers no arm.

DETERMINISTIC_TEXT_CONDITION.question: the policy admits UNRESOLVED_OTHER 'if deterministic semantic/structural text exists'. Which nodes fail that test?
DETERMINISTIC_TEXT_CONDITION.reading: A header-only CVT still asserts its Freebase type, which is deterministic signal; it is weak text, not absent text. Only the contentless fallbacks carry nothing at all.

ABLATION_ARMS_PREREGISTERED.note: DEFAULT under the ALL_NODE decision. CVT records carry composition, so entity text does not also need to carry the same arguments.
every CVT argument is serialised twice, once in the CVT record and again inside each adjacent entity. Redundant by construction under ALL_NODE.
the substitution arm: CVT information is flattened into entity text instead of being retrievable as its own unit.
strict exclusion with no compensation. Lower bound on corpus cost.
no CVT, no literal, flattened facts.
literals excluded from retrieval but retained in the graph and its partitions.
